versions.subject: rule: DumpMinitool usage
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\DumpMinitool.exe'
selection_original_name:
    OriginalName: 'DumpMinitool.exe'
selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' --processId '
        - ' --dumpType Full'
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\DumpMinitool.exe" OR OriginalName="DumpMinitool.exe" OR (CommandLine="* --processId *" CommandLine="* --dumpType Full*")
